svg.title: Lifeguard — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as lifeguard, wearing a collared shirt. Visible work cue: A long rescue float has two grip openings and a trailing safety strap. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: short curls, a softly squared face and round glasses.
